_about: The every-key fixture. Its job is to prove that a pack using every key the codecs declare still loads and generates, so the keys it demonstrates are demonstrably real rather than plausible.

probes.claim: the pinned building generates, so every key in the pack parsed

6.2.2.why: no overrideFloors on 6.2.2, so the building is a floor taller. Same cause as KEY-4
